Typed graph and source integrity

  • 169 reviewed typed imported/local material or guard edges; new Batch5 30. Source-use locators and proof-route IDs recorded. Scope guards and any unresolved physical prerequisites do not by themselves promote a theorem to unconditional physics.
  • 354 E1/E3/E4 evidence records; 90 source import certificates, 25 typed constructor/realization boundaries, 8 open issue origins.
  • Canonical global conditions are inherited or specialized using cross-references, not duplicated into fresh axioms. No unreviewed citation-only edge was made material. Existing unrelated atlas evidence and statuses remain preserved.
  • Full source-claim census complete; coverage is limited to the named/formal object universe and their source-consumed material prose/equations as reviewed, not an independent line-by-line rederivation of each equation by multiple agents.
  • Archive integration lives at DAG/AuditLayer/Paper5A-v1_1/Index.json linked from DAG/Paper00-TheoremDAG.json and updated combined route/material/forward/backward indices. Post-write readback/ZIP validation must pass before an atlas release is certified.

Batch5 exact tests

  • PASS primitive_root_unit_clifford_full_rank — T*T=I24; D^2=I48 and rank48.
  • PASS factorized_sector_gram_and_kernel — Sector-restricted ker(T) = ker(R), excluding complementary P-kernel.
  • PASS four_yukawa_slots_charge_weights — All four Dirac slot U(1) weights cancel exactly.
  • PASS yukawa_48_operator_trace_moments — 48x48 odd block, a=101, b=707, Tr Phi^2=2 a|H|^2, Tr Phi^4=2 b|H|^4.
  • PASS canonical_higgs_mass_and_moments — Tr XH^2=8π²; λ=8π²b/a²; m_h²=2λv².
  • PASS independent_sextic_dirichlet_Haar_moments — H6 Haar moments 0, 1/7, 0, 61/1001; 7²EH6⁴=427/143.
  • PASS yukawa_participation_24_support_bound — Example N=121/39; Cauchy and positivity endpoints 1≤N≤24.
  • PASS quark_color_tripling_participation — Quark-only example Neff=54/7; color repetition lower limit 3.
  • PASS scalar_gauge_shape_certificate — Neff=224/17 matches 17/7; Neff=24 gives 4/3.
  • PASS projective_Yukawa_Gram_factorization — Projective factorization Σρ_s²/(w_sp_s)=b/a² and Σρ_s=1.
  • PASS common_Yukawa_scale_cancellation — Uniform positive r cancels in Neff, λ and canonical Ys.
  • PASS canonical_fermion_comparison_mass_moments — Clocked jet c cancels; Σw tr M²=4π²v²; 4 Σw tr M⁴/Σw tr M² = m_h².
  • PASS heat_a4_graded_one_loop_weights — {'complex_scalar': Fraction(1, 3), 'Weyl': Fraction(2, 3), 'gauge': Fraction(-11, 3)}.
  • PASS standard_model_unbroken_beta_vector — One-loop (b1,b2,b3)=[Fraction(41, 10), Fraction(-19, 6), Fraction(-7, 1)].
  • PASS relative_grading_clifford_partner_192 — rank P+=96, complementary rank96, least Clifford-stable full rank192.
  • PASS Einstein_heat_raw_ratio_96 — κ=L²/(8π²), Uraw=8κ=L²/π²=96U.
  • PASS common_action_rescale_coupled — Rescaling by 1/96 fixes Uraw/U but changes every gauge g² by x96.
  • PASS gauge_trace_weights_and_common_heat_normalization — (k3,k2,kY)=(2,2,10/3); (g3²,g2²,gY²)/π²=(2,2,6/5); sin²=3/8; αs=π/2.
  • PASS icosian_exactness_domain_and_12_degree_guard — 2I 11-design is exact for quartic degree2 and sextic aliases ≤8; does not automatically cover degree12 sextic fourth moment.
  • PASS boundary_only_Schur_kernel_nogo — Boundary-factorized reduced action has exact kernel-annihilating Schur complement.
  • PASS Petersen_A5_induced_5_by_3_and_A4_regular — Petersen edges 5x3=15, A4 orbit12 regular; Vroot character {1: {3}, 3: {0}, 2: {-1}}.
  • PASS oriented_pair_rooted_frame_4D_tight — 5 unit w_r, cross overlap −1/4, tight 4D span eigenvalue 5/4.
  • PASS cyclic_quadratic_Pfaffian_and_fourier_bounds — Normal form P(x)=2ab e5 and (2ab)^2 ≤ (a²+b²)²; qω extremal a=b=1/√2.
  • PASS three_15_edge_Hodge_A5_equivariant_chars — A5-equivariant Hodge split E15/O15± with identical chars {'id': (15, 15, 15), 'double': (-1, -1, -1), 'three': (0, 0, 0), 'five': (0, 0, 0)}.
  • PASS bilinear_Petersen_projection_spectrum — J†J = rank15 idempotent on Λ²U; 15 ones, 30 zeros.
  • PASS rooted_module_intertwiner_dimension — Multiplicity count dim Hom_A4(U,Q⊗G)=1+9=10.
  • PASS block_central_static_source_commutant — Comm(M11⊕M4)=C I11⊕C I4; at most two distinct singular magnitudes.
  • PASS fivefold_chart_support_and_coset_cycle — A5 point-stabilizer index5; 5-cycle lies outside root stabilizer and permutes all 5 charts.
  • PASS root_involution_scalar_functional_mass_nogo — 48 singular values all1; f(D²)=f(1) I48 for any scalar spectral function.
  • PASS antiprism_full_rank_spectrum_import — Canonical antiprism characteristic (λ+2)(λ²−2λ−4), singular spectrum (√5−1,2,√5+1), det modulus8.

Final verdict: FULLY_AUDITED_WITH_OPEN_GAPS (scope and limitations above); no new Batch5 root gap, no basis to certify the physical completion steps as unconditional. The DAG and audit ZIPs contain only the newest current registered Paper5A layer/reports and preserve all prior unique paper audits and proof provenance.
